name: Gunslinger
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: High Perception; high skill based on Way; high Dex; moderate AC; low Will; high Reflex; low HP; high attack and extreme damage with guns; Slinger's Reload; Initial Deed; Gunslinger way, abilities associated with combat style and feats (Sword and Pistol or Dual-Weapon Reload)

notes.skills: A high skill from its way.
notes.defense: Moderate AC; high Reflex, low Will; low HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus and extreme damage with guns.
notes.specials: Slinger's Reload; Initial Deed; gunslinger's way; abilities and feats associated with its combat style (Sword and Pistol or Dual-Weapon Reload).
